findings.description: The caption states 2 leaves of 0.600 x 2.030 x 0.044 m in solid_wood_pine and a total of 22.4 kg. The stated area density is 17.6 kg/m2, so those leaves weigh 43 kg between them: the slab mass has been computed for one leaf and then split across all 2. Every leaf is 2x too light.
